judgment.rationale: This issue predates 0.101 and is already covered by active PR #50212 for the focus-loss stuck-toolbar path.
evidence: Original report was filed for PowerToys 0.79.0 and later commenters describe longstanding timing/focus-loss behavior.
Recent analysis says the toolbar is hidden only when the held letter key-up reaches KeyboardListener::OnKeyUp, leaving it orphaned if that key-up is missed.
PR #50212 is open for Quick Accent and its commit message says it closes #31988.
The PR changes KeyboardListener.cpp and KeyboardListener.h to hide the toolbar on EVENT_SYSTEM_FOREGROUND when focus leaves.
judgment.recommended_action: Track upstream PR #50212; no separate design/action.
